generatedProse.practice-connection:
In any subject, citation runs through almost everything you write. Every essay that draws on sources, every report with a reference list, every review of the literature depends on citing accurately and keeping to one style throughout. Getting it right protects your academic integrity and shows a marker the scope of your reading. Treat what follows as being about your own essays and reports, not about referencing in the abstract.

The same habit carries into working life. Wherever you draw on someone else's work, sourcing it clearly and consistently is what keeps your own work trustworthy, and it is a discipline you keep long after you graduate.
